preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N for x in P)
preconditions.description: P is a permutation of integers from 1 to N exactly once, where N is the length of P.
The length of P is exactly N, where N is the first integer in the test case.

preconditions.expression: T >= 1 and all(2 <= N <= 500 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) <= 500])
preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases (1 ≤ T ≤ 100), and each N is between 2 and 500 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_lines) == 3 * T for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines() for stdout in [stdout for _ in range(T)]])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output consists of exactly three lines: the minimum total cost, the number of operations K, and K lines of operations (i, j).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[0].isdigit() for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines() for stdout in [stdout for _ in range(T)]])
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case's output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum total cost to sort P.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout_lines[1]) <= N**2 for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines() for stdout in [stdout for _ in range(T)]])
postconditions.description: The second line of each test case's output is an integer K (0 ≤ K ≤ N²) representing the number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_lines) == int(stdout_lines[1]) + 2 for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines() for stdout in [stdout for _ in range(T)]])
postconditions.description: The number of operation lines (i, j) matches K for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(i) <= N and 1 <= int(j) <= N and int(i) != int(j) for i, j in [line.split() for line in stdout_lines[2:]]) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines() for stdout in [stdout for _ in range(T)]])
postconditions.description: Each operation (i, j) consists of two distinct indices between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(i) <= N and 1 <= int(j) <= N for i, j in [line.split() for line in stdout_lines[2:]]) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines() for stdout in [stdout for _ in range(T)]])
postconditions.description: Indices i and j in each operation are valid (1 ≤ i, j ≤ N).

postconditions.expression: all(sum(abs(int(i) - int(j)) for i, j in [line.split() for line in stdout_lines[2:]]) == int(stdout_lines[0]) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines() for stdout in [stdout for _ in range(T)]])
postconditions.description: The sum of costs of all operations equals the minimum total cost output in the first line.

postconditions.expression: all(all(P[i-1] == sorted_P[i-1] for i in range(1, N+1)) for P, sorted_P in [(P, sorted(P)) for P in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]])
postconditions.description: After performing all operations, the permutation P is sorted in increasing order.
